name: folder-dossier
title: Verified folder dossier
description: Turn a folder into a source-linked dossier, open-question list and proof-ready artifact.
prompt: Inspect {source} without modifying it. Build a concise dossier at {output}: scope, source inventory, findings with file references, contradictions, missing information and next actions. Read the finished file back before reporting completion.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Folder to inspect inside the project

checks: Every material claim cites at least one source path.
The artifact is read back after writing.
